**tuna-fonts 0.2.1**: a tray icon, two fixes, and the first update that installs itself. If you have 0.2.0, the app will offer it when you open it.

### New
- **It stays in the tray when you close the window**, so fonts from your watched folders stay available (asked for on Reddit). Click the tray icon to open it again; right-click for a small menu (search, discover, settings, quit) that follows the app's theme and language. If you prefer the old behaviour, *settings → when closing the window → quit*.
- **Open when Windows starts** (off by default): it starts hidden in the tray, so your watched folders are ready from the start. *Settings → open when windows starts*. It's just for your user, and uninstalling removes it.

### Fixed
- **Fonts installed "for all users" now show up.** Fonts you installed from File Explorer for every user, and the ones that come with Office, were treated as Windows fonts, so they were locked and hidden. Now only the fonts Windows itself ships with are locked; the rest show up in the list like your own (changing them still asks for admin rights).
- **Switching theme on the specimen of a font with thousands of characters** (Nerd Fonts, for example) no longer stalls halfway.
- **Language when coming from 0.1.0.** 0.1.0 always started in Spanish and saved it as your choice, so after updating it stayed in Spanish even on an English Windows. Now, if you never picked a language yourself, it follows your Windows language.

### Also
- A **Ko-fi** link in *settings → about*, in case you'd like to support the app. It stays free either way: no ads, no nagging.

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.2.1_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.2.1_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.2.1 se queda en la bandeja al cerrar la ventana, así que las fuentes de las carpetas vigiladas siguen disponibles (con clic derecho sale un menú con buscar, descubrir, ajustes y salir; o se cambia en ajustes), y puede abrirse al iniciar Windows, escondida en la bandeja (apagado por defecto). Además arregla dos cosas y es la primera que se instala sola desde la app. Las fuentes instaladas «para todos los usuarios» (las tuyas y las de Office) ya salen en la lista y sin candado; antes se trataban como fuentes de Windows y quedaban ocultas. Y si venías de la 0.1.0 con Windows en inglés, ahora sale en inglés: la 0.1.0 guardaba el español como si lo hubieras elegido tú. Cambiar de tema en el espécimen de una fuente con miles de caracteres ya no se atasca. Por último, hay un enlace a Ko-fi en *ajustes → acerca de*, por si quieres apoyarla; la app sigue siendo gratis igual.
